story_description: Users can instantly identify which AI provider a session is using through visual cues in the sidebar, eliminating confusion when working with multiple CLI backends.
task_description: Create reusable VendorLogo component and add image assets for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google providers that render in the sidebar session list.
atom: VendorLogo Component and Provider Logo Assets
atom_description: Implement VendorLogo SwiftUI view with 16px logo rendering, template rendering mode for theme adaptation, and SF Symbol fallback when assets are missing, plus add logo image assets for all three supported AI providers.
problem_statement: Users cannot easily distinguish which AI CLI backend a session is using when viewing the session list in the sidebar, making it difficult to context-switch between providers in a multi-CLI workflow.
scope_in: VendorLogo SwiftUI component with size parameter
Template rendering mode for light/dark theme adaptation
SF Symbol fallback when logo asset is missing
AIProvider extension with logoAssetName computed property
scope_out: Provider-specific logo coloring beyond template mode
Logo variations for different contexts outside sidebar
assumptions: AIProvider enum exists and has cases for anthropic, openai, and google
SF Symbols framework is available for fallback
The sidebar session list view will consume VendorLogo component
constraints: Logo assets must be sourced from official brand guidelines or be legally usable
Assets must include 1x, 2x, and 3x resolutions for Retina displays
Template rendering mode requires monochrome logo source images
SF Symbol fallback must be semantically appropriate for AI provider concept
functional_requirements: VendorLogo renders provider logo at configurable size defaulting to 16px
Logo uses template rendering mode to inherit foreground color from theme
When logo asset is missing, component displays SF Symbol server.rack as fallback
AIProvider.logoAssetName returns correct asset catalog name for each provider case
Logo maintains aspect ratio within the size frame
nonfunctional_requirements: Logo rendering must complete in under 16ms to not block main thread
Asset loading must not cause UI jank during sidebar scrolling
Memory footprint per logo instance should be under 1KB
implementation_steps: Implement VendorLogo struct conforming to View protocol
Add size property with CGFloat type and 16 default value
Add provider property with AIProvider type
Implement body computed property returning Image with resizable, frame, and renderingMode modifiers
Add Image init that tries asset name first and falls back to SF Symbol
Create AIProvider extension in same file with logoAssetName computed property
Implement switch statement returning logo-anthropic, logo-openai, logo-google strings
Add Contents.json with 1x, 2x, 3x image scale entries for logo-anthropic
Add monochrome PNG files for logo-anthropic at each resolution
Build project to verify asset catalog compilation
Run preview to verify logo rendering
data_model_changes: AIProvider enum extended with logoAssetName: String computed property
ui_states: Logo displayed state showing provider brand logo at specified size
Fallback state showing SF Symbol server.rack when asset is missing
Theme-adapted state showing logo in current theme foreground color
ui_interactions: Logo renders statically with no direct user interaction
Logo color updates automatically when system appearance changes
edge_cases: Asset catalog is corrupted or missing - fall back to SF Symbol
Provider enum case added without corresponding asset - fall back to SF Symbol
Very small size parameter under 8px - render at minimum 8px
Very large size parameter over 64px - render without distortion
Dark mode with high contrast accessibility setting - template mode adapts correctly
failure_modes: Missing asset file - SF Symbol fallback displays with warning log
Asset loading timeout - show placeholder and retry on next draw cycle
Memory pressure during asset decode - log warning and skip caching
rollback_plan: Delete VendorLogo.swift file, remove all logo-*.imageset directories from Assets.xcassets, and remove AIProvider extension. Run swift build to verify clean compilation.

unit: Test VendorLogo renders Image view for each AIProvider case
Test AIProvider.logoAssetName returns expected string for each case
Test VendorLogo with custom size parameter applies correct frame
Test VendorLogo fallback when asset name is invalid
integration: Test VendorLogo within sidebar SessionRowView renders correctly
Test logo appearance updates when ColorScheme environment changes
ui: Verify logo appears at correct size in sidebar row
Verify logo adapts color in dark mode via SwiftUI preview
Verify fallback SF Symbol appears when asset is deleted
perf: Measure logo rendering time in Instruments - must be under 16ms
Profile memory usage with 100 logo instances in List

metrics.name: logo_render_time_ms
metrics.notes: Track logo rendering performance to detect regressions

metrics.name: logo_fallback_count
metrics.notes: Count how often SF Symbol fallback is triggered indicating missing assets

acceptance_tests: Given a session with Anthropic provider, when sidebar displays, then Anthropic logo appears at 16px
Given dark mode enabled, when viewing sidebar, then logo color adapts to light foreground
Given missing logo asset, when VendorLogo renders, then SF Symbol server.rack displays as fallback
acceptance_criteria: Logos render at 16px default size in sidebar
Logos adapt to light and dark theme automatically via template rendering mode
SF Symbol fallback displays when any logo asset is missing
All three provider logo imagesets are present in Assets.xcassets

criteria: All three logo imagesets have 1x, 2x, and 3x PNG files
SwiftUI preview shows logo rendering correctly
Dark mode preview shows logo adapting to theme

completed_when: VendorLogo component renders correct provider logos in sidebar session list with theme adaptation and fallback behavior.
completed_evidence: Screenshot showing sidebar with sessions for all three providers displaying distinct logos, plus dark mode screenshot showing theme adaptation.
dependencies: Requires AIProvider enum to exist with anthropic, openai, and google cases. Requires DesignSystem/Components directory structure to exist.
status_reason: Awaiting completion of AIProvider enum and sidebar session list views before logo integration.
open_questions: Should logos have hover effects in sidebar for better affordance?
Are official brand logo assets available or do we need to create simplified versions?
notes: Template rendering mode requires monochrome source images. If vendor provides colored logos only, they must be converted to single-channel alpha masks. Consider using SVG source and converting to PDF for resolution independence.

na_justifications.event_contracts[0]: This atom does not emit events; it is a pure UI component that renders static images
na_justifications.ui_copy[0]: Logo component has no text content; it displays images only
na_justifications.test_plan.security[0]: Logo rendering has no security implications; assets are bundled locally with no user input processing
na_justifications.contracts.state[0]: Logo component is stateless; it renders based on provider prop with no internal state management
na_justifications.contracts.persistence[0]: Logo component does not persist any data; assets are read-only from the asset catalog

verification_steps: Run swift build and verify VendorLogo.swift compiles without errors
Open Xcode project and verify all three logo imagesets appear in Assets.xcassets navigator
Open VendorLogo.swift SwiftUI preview and verify each AIProvider case renders a distinct logo
Toggle Xcode preview between light and dark appearance and verify logo color adapts
Delete one logo asset file temporarily, rebuild, and verify SF Symbol fallback appears

risks: Brand logo usage may have trademark or licensing restrictions
Monochrome template rendering may lose brand recognizability
Asset catalog structure may conflict with existing imagesets
mitigations: Research each vendor brand guidelines for logo usage permissions before finalizing assets
Test logo recognizability with users at 16px size before shipping
Use unique logo- prefix for imageset names to avoid conflicts
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects only VendorLogo component and Assets.xcassets. No impact on existing views until integrated. Low risk of regression.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If brand licensing issues arise, replace logos with SF Symbols for each provider type. server.rack for Anthropic, cpu for OpenAI, globe for Google as temporary placeholders.
